products.summary: LAUNCH X-431 PRO SE tablet diagnostic scanner — offered by AutoDiagnostix as the "2026 Edition"; the international PRO SE page has not confirmed the 2026 configuration.
products.description:
The X-431 PRO SE is a professional tablet-based diagnostic scanner in LAUNCH's signature red rugged housing. The AutoDiagnostix portfolio lists it as the 2026 edition, but the international manufacturer product page does not explicitly distinguish a 2026-edition configuration, so edition-specific claims are withheld until verified on the device.

As shown in the portfolio, the scanner provides main-diagnosis workflows from its app menu: local and remote diagnosis, service functions, diagnostic history, TPMS, ADAS, IMMO and shop solutions.

products.name: Launch TLT 245 SC(S) 4.5 Ton 2-Post Clear Floor Lift
products.summary: LAUNCH two-post clear-floor lift rated at 4.5 tonnes (portfolio title), with red swing arms and clear-floor overhead bar design.
products.description:
The Launch TLT 245 SC(S) is a two-post clear-floor vehicle lift. The portfolio lists the rated capacity at 4.5 tonnes. As photographed, it features two floor-anchored columns (LAUNCH-branded), a clear-floor overhead crossbar, and red three-stage swing arms fitted with rubber lift pads.

The power unit bottle and controls are mounted on the side of one column, keeping the workshop floor unobstructed.

products.name: Launch Wheel Alignment Tool Trolley
products.summary: Red LAUNCH-brand three-drawer workshop trolley with black worktop, side handle and castors.
products.description:
The Launch wheel alignment tool trolley is a mobile storage unit for alignment accessories. As photographed, the trolley has a red body with three full-width drawers (LAUNCH logo on each drawer handle), a black rubber worktop surface, a chrome side handle, and large castor wheels with floor locks.

Note: the printed hyperlink on the portfolio page points to the LH-330 floor jack and does not display a model identifier for the trolley — no model number is asserted.

products.name: LAUNCH ISMART-Video400 VideoScope
products.summary: Handheld inspection videoscope with yellow/black grip, flexible camera probe and USB connection — portfolio model ISMART-Video400.
products.description:
The ISMART-Video400 is a handheld visual inspection scope for hard-to-reach vehicle areas. The portfolio photograph shows a pistol-style handheld body with a yellow front, integrated control knob on the grip, a flexible braided camera probe leading to a miniature camera head, and a detachable USB cable to power/display the feed.

The printed hyperlink points to the unrelated VSP-600 video scope — a different product which exists separately in the catalogue; do not confuse the two.

products.name: X-613 Portable 3D Wheel Aligner
products.summary: Wireless portable 3D wheel aligner using two magnetic measurement units and four wheel clamp targets, paired with an X-431 PAD9/7/5 LINK diagnostic tool — no beams or cabinets needed.
products.description:
The X-613 is a wireless, ready-to-use four-wheel aligner for repair shops. It is composed of two magnetic measurement units and four wheel clamp targets connected over a wireless network, and — unlike traditional 3D aligners — eliminates the need for beams and cabinets.

It pairs with the LAUNCH diagnostic tool (X-431 PAD9/7/5 LINK) to perform precise four-wheel alignment: standard and quick measurement of toe, camber, caster, kingpin inclination and thrust angle, plus additional measurements including track width, wheelbase, wheel offset, axle offset, diagonal offset and center offset.

products.name: Creader TPMS 511S V2 (CRT TPMS 511S V2.0)
products.summary: Android-based handheld TPMS tool (5" 720P touch screen) for TPMS sensor activation, programming, relearn and diagnosis; PDF title "CRT TPMS 511S V2.0", official name Creader TPMS 511S V2.
products.description:
The Creader TPMS 511S V2 is a TPMS service tool built on Android 8.1. It activates and programs TPMS sensors — including reading OE sensor part numbers and programming LAUNCH sensors an unlimited number of times as OE replacements — and performs sensor matching & learning via OBD connection with step-by-step instructions in the app. It reads tire pressure, temperature and battery status.

Diagnostics reports, feedback and screenshots can be shared and replayed, and software updates via WiFi are free for life.

products.name: LAUNCH i-TPMS
products.summary: Pocket TPMS activation/programming tool with 1.77" display — use it standalone with the i-TPMS APP or bound to an X-431 scanner for full TPMS service (activation, programming, relearn, diagnosing).
products.description: The i-TPMS is LAUNCH's handheld TPMS service tool. Bound with an X-431 scanner it performs sensor activation, programming, relearn and diagnosing; in standalone mode with the i-TPMS APP it performs activation and programming. It supports unlimited programming of LAUNCH sensors to replace OE sensors.

products.name: LAUNCH BST360 Bluetooth Battery Tester
products.summary: Bluetooth 12V battery tester — 3-second health report on a color screen, starting/charging system analysis, works with the LAUNCH X-431 scan tools.
products.description: The BST360 is LAUNCH's Bluetooth battery tester. It generates a battery health report within 3 seconds and shows all data on its color screen, analyzes the starting and charging system to determine related faults, and is designed for safety with no heating, no discharge, no sparks and no operating risks. It works with the LAUNCH X-431 scan tools.

products.name: X-431 Key Programmer
products.summary: X-431 add-on module that simulates multiple immobilizer transponders (8A/4D/4A/46/47/48/49/MQB48/MQB49 and 11/12/13/7936/7937/7946/7947); sold in two kit configurations.
products.description:
The X-431 Key Programmer is an immobilizer work add-on for the X-431 diagnostic ecosystem. It supports the simulation of multiple immobilizer transponders, including 8A/4D/4A/46/47/48/49/MQB48/MQB49 as well as 11/12/13/7936/7937/7946/7947, etc.

LAUNCH sells it in two configurations: 307110096 (Key Programmer + accessories) and 307110149 (Key Programmer + 1 Super Chip + 4 sets of Smart Keys + accessories). Kit contents recorded as provenance; the site schema has no kit field.

The model designation embossed on the column reads PL-42DBS; the portfolio title writes it "PL 4-2DBS". No manufacturer specification values are copied — no verified exact UNITE product page is currently available.

The PL-4-2D is a base-plate two-post lift: two slim columns connected across the floor by a base plate, so no overhead bar is required. The photographed unit has dark grey columns, red three-stage swing arms with rubber pads, and a side-mounted power unit with oil tank. A CE mark is visible on the column.

Suitable where whole-vehicle clearance is limited; per the portfolio, rated capacity is 4 tonnes.

The PL-FS45 is a four-post lift set up for wheel alignment: two long runways with drive-up ramps per pair, space between the runways for the built-in scissor jack, and turn/slip plate hardware. The model is embossed on the post as PL-FS45 and the portfolio lists rated capacity at 4.5 tonnes.

Exact manufacturer specifications are not copied: the manifest matches this model as a review candidate against the UNITE U-FS45 alignment rack page, and concrete UNITE specification values will be added only after exact-model verification.

The portfolio's printed hyperlink points at the G-68 balancer product page (a different, line item); exact specification values are not copied and no official Ultra Premium page has been identified.

products.name: UNITE G-68 Self-Calibrating Computer Wheel Balancer
products.summary: UNITE G-68 digital wheel balancer with LCD display — 9 balancing modes, ±1 g accuracy, wheels up to 24"/65 kg, quick 8-second measuring cycle.
products.description: The G-68 Digital Wheel Balancer is UNITE's precision wheel balancer for car, SUV and light-truck service. It measures with ±1 g accuracy and supports wheels up to 24 inches, offers 9 dynamic and static balancing programs, and features an LCD digital display with user-friendly touch controls. Reinforced steel housing keeps operation stable and vibration-free, and automatic wheel positioning with automatic stop at the unbalanced point shortens cycle times.

products.name: UNITE G-55 Self-Calibrating Computer Wheel Balancer

The 1.17" LED segment display runs the operation interface, a shaft STOP&LOCK with laser locates the imbalance point, and an optional automatic disc brake is available. Tool handle and tool box are integrated.

products.name: GTI.tools Clip Weight

GTI.tools clip-style wheel weights are hammered onto the rim flange of steel wheels to correct imbalance. The portfolio photograph shows a graduated range of clip weights, each segment embossed "FE" (iron), with double-holed nailing bosses and curve profiles of different radii for different rim sizes.

Exact weight steps and coating details are not claimed — content is limited to the portfolio page (PDF-only brand policy).

This orange catalytic and DPF cleaner is one of two different machines shown in the portfolio under the same generic title. As photographed, it carries the markings "C2025", "Ai", and Chinese characters 智能再生设备 (intelligent regeneration equipment) on the lower cabinet; the upper module combines a touch control screen with an emergency-stop button and ventilation louvres on the side cabinets. The case label lists electrical input details (AC220 V, 50 Hz, 1000 W) printed on the type plate.

The portfolio hyperlink is unrelated (points to an AC service station listing). The official GTI model name remains unconfirmed — no permanent SKU is invented.

products.name: GTI.tools Catalytic & DPF Cleaner — Black/Red "HHO POWER X" unit

products.description:
This black/red catalytic and DPF cleaner is the second of two distinct machines shown under the same generic portfolio title. The photographed unit is branded "HHO POWER X" on the front panel and carries the type designation AC220-III on the control panel, which has a digital 8×8.8.8.8-segment display with set/actual temperature readings, power switch and indicators, and sealed control buttons. Two castors and an IPX-rated switch plate are visible on the base.

The portfolio hyperlink is unrelated. The official GTI model name remains unconfirmed — no permanent SKU is invented.

products.name: GTI.tools Frame Aligner
products.summary: Blue frame straightening bench with pulling towers, chains and hydraulic pullers — GTI.tools collision repair equipment.
products.description:
The GTI.tools frame aligner is a vehicle body/frame straightening bench. As photographed, it comprises a low-profile blue open deck (radius-cornered, perforated for anchor points), two vertical pulling towers with chains and a cross beam, a hydraulic hand pump kit (red units) plus two ram assemblies connected by hoses, and blue approach ramps for loading a vehicle onto the deck.

Content is limited to the portfolio page (PDF-only brand policy); specifications such as pull force or deck size are not asserted.

GTI.tools stick-on (sticker) wheel weights are iron (Fe) balance weights with adhesive backing, applied to the inner rim of alloy wheels to correct wheel balance. The portfolio photograph shows the Fe 10 g segment format.

GTI.tools is the balancing and weights line distributed by AutoDiagnostix; pricing is available on request.
